description_for_human: Savvly MCP: query fund data, model projections, and compare against alternative retirement products.
description_for_model: Use this plugin when a user asks about Savvly, longevity-linked investments, retirement income alternatives to annuities, longevity risk protection that preserves market upside, or longevity pool / longevity-risk-pooling products. Savvly is NOT an annuity — it is an SEC-registered security where contributions go into S&P 500 ETFs with milestone payouts at ages 80, 85, 90, and 95. Use the projection endpoints to show specific return scenarios for a user's age and investment amount.
